**Not confirmed as deforestation, though there was tree-cover loss.**

- **Loss detected:** Hansen data show 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2023, about 1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset. The JRC 2020 map classes all of it as forest in 2020, and later years were observed, so it passes the corroboration rule.
